title: Oakveil (Backwoods)
description: A liminal horror adventure mod based on Woodlands
body:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/605c39b45ea03005ed3aa5a5517d32a8c95a111b.png)

Backwoods is a liminal-horror adventure mod for NeoForge 1.21.1. Enter a decayed wooden world and navigate a network of connected dimensions: Backwoods, The Grain, The Still, The Familiar, Rotting, and Loss.

Face Woodbound entities like Splinters and their variants, stalking, pathing, and hunting through terrain. Use progression items such as fragments, draughts, geodes, and effigies to survive escalating routes and recover control.
